column5: GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/bodies_and_transitions.rs:1068-1107` (checked): when Boolean-literal arm tuples cover all 2^n combinations, the last arm's guard becomes `Always`. Wrong program per the reader: one whose tuples cover all cases "only syntactically (for example subjects that are not Boolean-typed)". What stage 05 does with the unguarded arm was not traced.
GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/contracts_and_parameters.rs:743-757`: a repeated `terminates by` overwrites the earlier one; the last witness wins.

GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/declarations.rs:51-55, 760-764, 806-810`: `;` after data fields, case members and capability fields is optional, so `a: u8 b: u8` parses. `S01/expressions.rs:2081-2124`: `T { a: 1 b: 2 }` parses.
GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/declarations.rs:1205`: a domain on a reference or generic carrier with no type parameters is named `?::Name`.

GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/statements_and_assembly.rs:1900-2107`: the bracketed-operand rejection is skipped for port, MSR, control-register, system-register, flags, fence and GDT shapes; wrong program per the reader: "`out [x], y` style bracketed operands".
GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/tokens_and_storage.rs:117-125`: the span builder never checks that pushed handles are adjacent (callers read were adjacent; inferred).

GROUP: **Stage 01** | - `S01/type_syntax_and_patterns.rs:201-210`: a destructured binding used inside a call's `machine_arguments`, `evidence_arguments` or `target` is not rewritten. `:145`: the original capture is kept when no copy matches.

GROUP: **Stage 02** | - `S02/constant.rs:94-179`: non-builtin or non-numeric cases return `Ok(())` in the carrier re-landing; example given: "a `bool` const with an integer literal". `:373-456`: scalar or alias destinations skip the nominal check. `:519-564`: an alias of `f32` skips the scalar check. `:690-719`: a path with an invalid head symbol falls to a name lookup and becomes the const.
